name: Idol Project ~Producer Nogami Yuuki no Ura Manual~
original_name: アイドルプロジェクト～プロデューサー野上裕紀の裏マニュアル～
source:
One day while returning from the convenience store, protagonist Yuuki Nogami is hit by a car.

The injury is minor, but an altercation with the sleazy driver turns into a hit-and-run, with Yuuki holding a business card and a grudge. He decides to go to the company on the card to seek damages, but when he shows the card, a case of mistaken identity turns Yuuki into an idol producer!

The opportunity to screw up the hit-and-run's salary and business affairs is just too fun to resist, and the chance to exploit hot young up-and-comers has Yuuki trembling in his pants!

[From DLsite English]
translation:
某天，主角野上祐紀從便利商店回家途中被汽車撞倒。

傷勢並不嚴重，他與猥瑣司機發生爭執後，對方卻駕車逃逸，只給祐紀留下一張名片和滿腔怨氣。他決定前往名片上的公司求償，出示名片時卻因一場身分誤會，莫名其妙成了偶像製作人！

有機會攪亂肇事逃逸者的薪水和工作，實在有趣得令人無法抗拒；想到還能利用年輕性感的未來偶像，祐紀更是興奮得渾身發抖！

[譯自英文版DLsite]
